mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates on future corporate cash flows and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.5% over a 3-month window signals weakening labor market conditions, which triggers a shift in Fed policy toward rate cuts, boosting equity risk appetite and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.5% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction starts (HOUST) and personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong underlying demand momentum, which drives corporate earnings expectations higher and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS rise simultaneously (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 117.0 for two consecutive months indicates weakening supply-side activity, which signals an impending economic slowdown and triggers risk-off behavior, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 50% of instances where INDPRO remains below 117.0 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% combined with a decline in CPIAUCSL below 190.0 signals a disinflationary monetary tightening cycle, which reduces inflation expectations and lowers real rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL < 190.0 are simultaneously true (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in real personal consumption (RSAFS) below 350,000 million dollars combined with a decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) below 2.0% annualized signals a weakening demand environment, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both RSAFS < 350000 and GDPC1 < 2.0% are true (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate model.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 250,000 in a single month, combined with a declining unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals strong labor market tightening, which increases inflationary pressure and prompts the Fed to maintain high rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 250000 AND UNRATE declines in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when PAYEMS > 250000 and UNRATE declines in the same month (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 117.0 for three consecutive months, combined with a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.3%, indicates a supply-demand imbalance with weakening output and labor market stress, which triggers a risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 117.0 for 3 consecutive months AND UNRATE > 5.3%
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both INDPRO < 117.0 for 3 months and UNRATE > 5.3% are true (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate model.
